videos.headline: Telangana's vehicle codes lost viewers early: 35.6% stayed to watch.

why.text: Stayed to watch 35.6%, held after the hook 20.4%.
The biggest fall, 20.2 points at 6.5 s, is on "केंद्र शासित प्रदेश की गाड़ी पर" (the union territory plate line).

videos.next: Keep the second beat on the one surprising code change, not a list of plate codes.
